beats.title: Morning at college: greeting and twin dynamics
beats.reading: Bantu approaches Dhika with his routine compliment; Bobby is nearby and mostly quiet. The narration establishes how differently each twin communicates with her.
beats.before_after: Teacher-student familiarity already exists; this scene makes their different interaction styles explicit.

beats.title: Her reaction to Bantu's routine compliments
beats.reading: Dhika asks him to lower his voice. The narrator distinguishes her earlier discomfort from her more familiar response now; Bobby is not the speaker.
beats.before_after: What once embarrassed her is becoming a familiar routine; this is not blanket permission.

beats.title: 4 PM: staff-room conversation and different observations
beats.reading: Both twins arrive before leaving college. Bantu initiates the exchange, while Bobby remains quieter; Dhika notices Bobby looking away and reacts with embarrassment.

body_refs.reading: The sari is low at Dhika's hip and a small area of hip skin is exposed. Bobby looks at it; Dhika notices Bobby's gaze. Bantu is present in the meeting but is not identified as the observer in this line.
body_refs.subject: Dhika

beats.title: Ride request: transport explanation versus narrator information
beats.reading: Bantu asks for a lift and supplies a practical explanation. The narrator separately says his transport problem was a pretext; Dhika agrees to take both students.
beats.before_after: Dhika hears a transport request; the reader knows Bantu's motivation was different.

beats.title: Walking toward the scooter: who observes whom
beats.reading: As Dhika walks toward the parking area, both twins notice her appearance. Bantu also catches Bobby looking and lightly taps Bobby's shoulder; Bobby blushes. This is the context missing from the old label 'gaze during walk'—observation during a particular transition, not a standalone encounter or touch involving Dhika.

body_refs.mode: Observed by both twins; no contact with Dhika
body_refs.reading: During the walk toward the scooter, Bantu looks toward Dhika. The same source line separately shows Bantu noticing Bobby's attention and tapping Bobby's shoulder; this tap is not contact with Dhika.
body_refs.subject: Dhika

beats.title: Scooter seating: Bobby is in the middle
beats.reading: At the scooter, Dhika instructs Bobby to sit in the middle and Bantu behind. Bobby sits first; both students have different private responses to the seating arrangement.

beats.title: Ride: support instruction and unexpected contact
beats.reading: Dhika expects Bobby to hold her shoulders for balance, but he holds a different part of her clothing-covered side. She notices additional movement, feels awkward and continues the short ride without confronting him.

body_refs.reading: On the scooter, Bobby holds Dhika around her hip/waist and stomach rather than the shoulders she expected; the narration distinguishes his completed grip from her instruction.
body_refs.subject: Dhika

body_refs.reading: During the ride, Dhika notices finger movement and contact near her hip. The narration attributes the movement to Bobby, not Bantu.
body_refs.subject: Dhika

beats.before_after: Dhika knows what she felt; Bantu is not shown as knowing the details.

beats.title: Arrival: different goodbyes and unequal knowledge
beats.reading: Both twins thank Dhika. Bantu is frustrated about the seat arrangement; Bobby privately keeps the details of his ride interaction to himself.
beats.before_after: The group ride ends, but their knowledge and emotional responses are not identical.

beats.title: Later recollection: Bantu's earlier compliments
beats.reading: A later thought refers back to the existing pattern of Bantu's compliments. This is memory, not a third meeting.

beats.title: Noon staff room: Bantu speaks, Bobby initially quiet
beats.reading: The students approach Dhika at college. Bantu begins the conversation and Dhika refers back to the previous ride while talking to Bobby.
beats.before_after: The E01 ride is explicitly remembered here, not repeated.

beats.title: Extra tuition: request, purpose, agreement, schedule
beats.reading: The twins explain their physics ambitions; Bobby asks for help, Bantu clarifies the request, and Dhika agrees to extra lessons. The first schedule and a trip to show them her home are arranged.
beats.before_after: They move from only college interactions to planned extra tuition at her home.

beats.title: After college: trip to Dhika's home
beats.reading: Dhika rides ahead with the twins following separately. After a stop for groceries, they reach her apartment and she asks Bobby to retrieve a key.

beats.title: At the door: Bobby finds the key, both enter
beats.reading: Bobby handles the key and opens the apartment door. Dhika lets both students enter; nothing in these lines is a separate solo meeting.

beats.title: Major turning point: accidental sari-drape slip
beats.reading: While carrying bags, Dhika accidentally loses part of her sari drape. The source describes partial upper-chest visibility (approximately one-third). She initially reacts to the falling bag, then restores her clothing. It is presented as an accident, not a planned reveal.

body_refs.reading: Dhika's bag catches the sari pallu; as it slips, part of her upper chest becomes visible (the narrator describes approximately one-third). She restores the drape. Neither twin causes the slip.
body_refs.actor: Accident, not initiated by either twin
body_refs.subject: Dhika

body_refs.reading: Dhika initially reaches for the fallen bag, then fixes her sari drape. This is her own action and a shared scene; not a touch by either student.
body_refs.subject: Dhika

beats.before_after: The unexpected incident changes the group's comfort and the immediate conversation.

beats.title: Different twin reactions and rushed departure
beats.reading: Bobby initially keeps looking; Bantu averts his gaze. Dhika withdraws briefly to another room. On her return, Bobby has already gone outside and Bantu ends the visit quickly.
beats.before_after: Bobby and Bantu do not react identically; the encounter ends abruptly.

body_refs.area: Accidental clothing visibility and onlooker reaction
body_refs.reading: After the accidental pallu slip, Bobby continues looking at the exposed area; Bantu, by contrast, averts his gaze. Both see the incident, but their responses are distinct.
body_refs.subject: Dhika

body_refs.reading: Bantu looks away after the accidental drape incident. This is the Bantu-specific visual response; Bobby's continued observation belongs to the Bobby track.
body_refs.subject: Dhika

beats.title: Immediately afterward: fear and uncertainty
beats.reading: Dhika worries about what the students might say and how she will face them next time. These are her interpretations; neither twin is present for this reflection.

beats.title: Later that night: conversation with John
beats.reading: Dhika recounts the incident to John. His response is more dismissive than she expects; her embarrassment and worry remain. The twins are absent, so this is not a new twin encounter.

beats.title: Next day: avoidance and comparison to Chotu
beats.reading: Dhika considers avoiding college, and later privately compares her comfort in different relationships. This is a memory/interpretation beat rather than a direct encounter.

beats.title: First extra lesson: meeting again after E02
beats.reading: An arranged tuition visit brings Dhika and both twins together. The earlier home incident is explicitly recalled while the new lesson begins.

beats.title: Conversation, clothing choices and lesson resumes
beats.reading: The dialogue tests comfort and boundaries; Dhika makes choices about her attire and responds separately to each twin. The lesson continues.

beats.title: Following class: previous incident resurfaces
beats.reading: A later tuition class includes another conversation about what happened previously, differing reactions and concerns about others knowing.

beats.title: Reassurance and disagreement within the group
beats.reading: Bobby speaks more openly, while Bantu also contributes. The participants respond with reassurance and hesitation; the narrator distinguishes some information not shared with John.

beats.title: Home tuition: heat, clothing and discomfort
beats.reading: The shared class moves through everyday talk, temperature and personal comfort; Bantu and Bobby do not always give the same answers.

beats.title: Requests, explanations and negotiated choices
beats.reading: A sequence of requests, objections and decisions occurs. The reader must not treat a request or a narrated feeling as a completed action.

beats.title: Shared conversation: visual attention and stopping cues
beats.reading: Dialogue and reactions continue while Dhika gives specific limits and the twins respond differently. Individual actions must be attributed to the correct person.

beats.title: Later discussion and immediate scene outcome
beats.reading: The class scene continues with further conversation and private reactions. Review the linked source before assigning knowledge or a new relationship state.

beats.title: Previous visit continues: goodbye
beats.reading: E05 begins before the ongoing group encounter has fully ended. The twins and Dhika exchange different farewell responses; no new separate meeting should be counted merely because the episode number changed.

beats.title: Separate encounter: Dhika meets Bantu while shopping
beats.reading: Bantu meets Dhika separately during her shopping errand. Bobby is absent. Conversation develops around the errand and an outfit choice.

beats.title: Shopping visit continues: reactions and departure
beats.reading: Their exchange continues with questions, suggestions, boundaries and Dhika's responses. This remains the same Bantu-only encounter.

beats.title: Private thought recalling Bantu
beats.reading: Dhika reflects on an earlier comment from Bantu. This is not an in-person repeat.

beats.title: Twins respond to cancelled tuition
beats.reading: Dhika informs the twins that the class will not take place; she hears both react. The narration does not certify an in-person meeting here.

beats.title: Bobby visits alone: competition request
beats.reading: Bobby arrives without Bantu and asks for help preparing for a physics competition. His private purpose and what Dhika hears are recorded separately.

beats.title: Solo tuition: increased dialogue, then interruption
beats.reading: Dhika encourages Bobby to speak more and they begin studying. Shyness, reassurance and visual observations alternate; a doorbell interrupts the solo meeting.

beats.title: Chotu arrives: Bobby asks to stay
beats.reading: Dhika introduces Bobby and Chotu. Bobby first offers to leave, then asks whether he may stay and help. Dhika accepts the request.

beats.title: Shared painting and an accident
beats.reading: The three work together. When Dhika slips, Bobby and Chotu respond; each person's action is tracked separately rather than combined into a single generic group reaction.

beats.title: Practical help, Bobby's goodbye and exit
beats.reading: Bobby and Chotu provide practical assistance after the fall. Bobby then says goodbye and leaves. Later Chotu-only events must not be attributed to Bobby.

beats.title: Monday: Bantu arrives alone to change lesson arrangements
beats.reading: Bantu comes to Dhika's apartment without Bobby and explains an upcoming trip. Dhika agrees to remote tuition while they are away.

beats.title: Solo visit: teasing, requests and limits
beats.reading: The conversation shifts from everyday talk to appearance, relationships and comfort. Requests, refusals, internal hesitation and actual actions should be distinguished.

beats.title: Gift discussion: objections, explanation and acceptance
beats.reading: Bantu offers a gift. Dhika initially refuses on teacher-role grounds; after further explanation and pressure, she reluctantly accepts. Her acceptance of the gift does not establish agreement to later requests.

beats.title: Visit continues: reaction, boundaries, departure
beats.reading: Bantu and Dhika continue their discussion. The visit includes further requests and responses before Bantu leaves; Bobby is not present.

beats.title: Wednesday: recalling an earlier suggestion
beats.reading: Dhika remembers Bantu's earlier suggestion while preparing alone. This callback belongs in memory, not as an additional Bantu meeting.

beats.title: Wednesday: shared online tuition opens
beats.reading: Dhika joins a video call with both twins. Bobby explains the physics competition and the lesson begins; this is remote rather than in-person contact.

beats.title: Online lesson: conversation and unresolved ending
beats.reading: The group exchanges comments and reacts during the video call. The chapter ends while Dhika checks the video; the same encounter continues at the start of E08.
beats.before_after: E07 ending is an open boundary, not a completed call.

beats.title: The previous episode's video call ends
beats.reading: Dhika examines her video display, reacts abruptly to a concern about how clothing appeared, asks Bantu about his earlier suggestion, and ends the lesson. Both twins are confused; Bantu decides to go see her.
beats.before_after: This call began E07 and closes in E08. No second meeting was held here.

beats.title: Alone afterward: role concerns and guilt
beats.reading: After disconnecting, Dhika checks the clothing detail that troubled her. She reflects privately on feeling responsible, differentiates her role as a teacher from other relationships, and questions whether anger at Bantu was fair.
beats.before_after: Her internal interpretation changes before the next encounter. The twins have not heard this reasoning.

beats.title: Later the same day: Bobby's missed calls and Bantu arrives
beats.reading: Dhika wakes to missed calls from Bobby. Bantu then arrives in person and asks to enter. The missed calls do not make Bobby a participant in Bantu's visit.

beats.title: Greeting, apology and clarification
beats.reading: Dhika welcomes Bantu with an embrace and apologizes for her earlier reaction. The two discuss a mistaken interpretation of a clothing detail; Bantu learns why she was concerned.

body_refs.subject: Dhika and Bantu
body_refs.reading: Dhika initiates an embrace when Bantu arrives, followed by his reassuring response. This is a new in-person visit, not continuation of the call.

beats.title: Teacher role, reputation, trust and a possible trip
beats.reading: Dhika explains why she worried about others learning of the call. Bantu reassures her and reports that he and Bobby hope she will be their companion if they win the science competition. She appreciates the reassurance but privately doubts her readiness for that travel responsibility.
beats.before_after: The source establishes what Bantu says about their intentions; Bobby is absent, and no trip commitment is established.

beats.title: Questions, teasing and visible reactions
beats.reading: After the serious discussion, the conversation shifts into banter and repeated questions about appearance and reactions. The source distinguishes the two participants' actual speech from Dhika's unspoken curiosity.

beats.title: Personal observations, a request and stopping cues
beats.reading: Bantu moves closer and makes further comments, prompting Dhika to respond and sometimes object. A clothing-boundary request is followed by her verbal protest and playful response; one permitted exchange must not be treated as permission for every later request.

beats.title: Slip and assistance: separate accident from deliberate support
beats.reading: Dhika slips near the sofa. Bantu helps her up, asks whether she is hurt, and offers assistance for her knee. The narrative then distinguishes an accidental movement from a separate subsequent action; the two must not be merged into one generic 'help' label.

body_refs.subject: Dhika
body_refs.reading: After she slips, Bantu supports Dhika by her hips to help her back onto the sofa. The source explains the immediate practical purpose.

body_refs.subject: Dhika
body_refs.reading: Bantu checks her knee after the fall and tries to ease discomfort. Later movements are separately described in the source.

beats.title: Departure and plan for Bobby to attend the next session
beats.reading: Dhika needs to collect Pappu. Bantu says he will be away until Monday, but Bobby can attend Friday's online lesson. Dhika thanks him before he leaves.
beats.before_after: Bantu exits. The new Friday plan concerns Bobby, but is not itself a Bobby encounter.

beats.title: Separate Bobby contact: apology by phone
beats.reading: After Bantu leaves, Dhika calls Bobby to apologize for the earlier video-call reaction. This is a distinct off-scene phone interaction, not Bobby joining the Bantu meeting.

beats.title: A new Bobby Skype call begins
beats.reading: During an unrelated part of her day, Dhika receives repeated Skype calls and discovers Bobby is calling. She joins the call; the narrative records an unexpected appearance and Bobby's immediate response. She considers getting dressed before returning.

beats.title: Conversation: surprise, teasing and changing comfort
beats.reading: Bobby asks her to remain on the call. Their dialogue moves through teasing, visual reactions, and surprise that he is speaking more openly than usual. This is remote interaction—no physical contact between them is recorded.

beats.title: Bobby voices a request; scene breaks before the response is revealed
beats.reading: A request leads to confusion and clarification. Dhika sets conditions before considering it; the original chapter ends just as Bobby reacts to something not yet described. Its next scene belongs to the same video call in E09.
beats.before_after: Do not infer the final response from E08's cliffhanger: E09 continues the same Skype encounter.

beats.title: Open cliffhanger resolved: visual demonstration over Skype
beats.reading: The previous episode ended at Bobby's unresolved reaction. E09 first reveals what Dhika did during that same call; it is a remote visual exchange, not physical contact or a new meeting.
beats.review: SOURCE_LINKED_READING_FIRST_PASS; original source must resolve specific visual claims
beats.before_after: E08's last reaction now has a documented cause. The call remains the same ongoing Skype conversation.

beats.title: Bobby explains his preference; Dhika interprets his implication
beats.reading: Dhika notices Bobby's reaction and asks follow-up questions. Bobby replies shyly; the narrator distinguishes part of what he thinks from what he says aloud, while Dhika draws an interpretation.
beats.review: SOURCE_LINKED_READING_FIRST_PASS; original source must resolve specific visual claims
beats.before_after: Bobby becomes more willing to answer, but his private wording is not automatically spoken knowledge.

beats.title: Dhika asks a question and Bobby complies
beats.reading: Dhika asks Bobby to stand briefly during the remote call. He agrees and responds; she then asks him to sit. This remains video-mediated observation and dialogue, not in-person contact.
beats.review: SOURCE_LINKED_READING_FIRST_PASS; original source must resolve specific visual claims
beats.before_after: The request and Bobby's actual response are distinct; no direct physical contact occurs between the two.

beats.title: Skype conversation closes before the planned errand
beats.reading: Dhika says she needs to get ready for an errand and will see Bobby on Monday. The source moves directly into an unrelated plan; it does not describe an additional encounter with Bobby in this episode.
beats.review: SOURCE_LINKED_READING_FIRST_PASS; original source must resolve specific visual claims
beats.before_after: The E08→E09 Skype encounter ends; Monday is a future intention, not an encounter already completed.

beats.title: After the Skype scene: no further twin encounter
beats.reading: The narrative switches to a shopping trip, a Chotu-related home visit, and an evening social gathering with John, Sharmi and Raj. None of these is a new Bantu–Dhika or Bobby–Dhika meeting.
beats.review: SOURCE_LINKED_READING_FIRST_PASS; original source must resolve specific visual claims
beats.before_after: No new direct Bantu or Bobby meeting is established in the rest of E09.

body_ref_rules.scope: tracks means pair directly attributed; context_group is shared scene only
body_ref_rules.group_separation: A shared incident may involve multiple witnesses; do not infer identical reactions or contact
body_ref_rules.status: Only evidence_class COMPLETED_CONTACT marks completed physical contact; observation or attempted action never does
body_ref_rules.visibility: Clothing visibility is tracked non-graphically, with actor, observer and source reference
body_ref_rules.safety: Source is authoritative; interpretation is preliminary, not future prediction
